Downloading and executing malicious shell scripts to install AES.DDoS botnet malware
Using Empire PowerShell post-exploitation toolkit for further payload delivery

Attack Vector: Remote exploitation of vulnerable Confluence Server versions via server-side template injection
Use of CertUtil LOLBin to download ransomware payload
Remote shell command execution to download and run malicious shell scripts
Indicators of Compromise: Multiple CVE-2019-3396 exploits publicly available since April 10
Use of Empire PowerShell post-exploitation toolkit
AES.DDoS botnet malware activity including DDoS attacks and system information exfiltration
